body:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Paging inference-ingress-prod (service: inference-ingress-prod) — triggered by increased 5xx ratio (alert: upstream-error-rate > 5% for 2m). PD: https://pagerduty.example/INC123456
Samira (oncall): acked. I'm on it. starting triage now.
Jae (eng-sre): thanks Samira. any visible spike in requests or a deploy?
Samira (oncall): no recent deploys in the last 30m according to deploy-bot. error traces show TLS handshake failures and 502s from model-router pods.
Priya (infra): pulling k8s events + svc map. suspicious: traffic is routing to inference-ingress-canary namespace due to a legacy service tag on the PD rule. that would hit a different service backing (old model pool).
Devon (eng-runtime): oh damn — that explains mismatch. the canary pool is v0.9 quantized nodes, they time out at higher concurrency.
Morgan (cust-success): any user impact? a few customers reported slow generative responses ~5-10m ago. ticketing shows retries increasing.
Samira (oncall): putting PD incident on short hold: pausing alerts for inference-ingress-prod while we mitigate.
Jae (eng-sre): suggestion: flip PD routing override to route to inference-ingress-main (correct service) and remove the legacy tag from the alert rule. can someone confirm PD service bindings?
Priya (infra): checking PD service bindings now. found binding: "inference-ingress-prod" -> tags: ["env:prod", "route:legacy-canary"]. that tag should not be present.
Devon (eng-runtime): quick mitigation: add a temporary routing rule in the gateway to redirect traffic away from canary nodes: kubectl patch svc gateway -n prod -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"pool":"main"}}}' (will revert after fix).
Samira (oncall): applying redirect. running the patch now.
incident-bot: Deploy bot: kubectl apply patch succeeded in 3 pods. health checks passing for gateway.
Samira (oncall): traffic shift looks good, 5xxs dropping from 7.5% -> 0.9% in the last 30s.
Jae (eng-sre): removing legacy tag from alert rule to prevent future fanout to wrong PD service. command: gcloud monitoring rules update --id projects/redwood/alertPolicies/alert-xyz --remove-tags route:legacy-canary
Priya (infra): updated PD service bindings to remove the tag. verified: PD will now target inference-ingress-main.
Samira (oncall): acknowledging that incident is mitigated for now. keeping PD incident open for postmortem. Samira -> handoff to Jae for follow-up and RCA.
Morgan (cust-success): informing affected customers: posting note that we experienced transient routing to canary nodes causing timeouts; all services restored; follow-up will explain root cause and next steps.
Devon (eng-runtime): immediate next steps: (1) ensure canary routing rules are gated by explicit deploy flags, (2) add a check in the alerting rule to include service.selector match so PD fanout uses explicit service id, (3) run a PD routing replay test in staging.
Jae (eng-sre): agreed. I'll own the RCA and action items. creating incident ticket INC123456-RCA and will include timelines + runbook updates.
Samira (oncall): thanks team. closing the triage loop. if anything spikes, page me. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC123456 status: acknowledged -> mitigated. duration: 12m. assigned: Jae (eng-sre).
